_comment: Project registry. Controls isolation and autonomy. The engine NEVER crosses project boundaries within a single task, and never overrides review_required. Copy to projects.json and list your own projects.

_autonomy_levels.auto-merge: AI may implement, review, and merge to main without asking. Default for low-risk projects.
_autonomy_levels.auto-pr: AI may implement and open a PR, but a human merges.
_autonomy_levels.review-required: AI may implement in a worktree but must stop and ask before ANY push. Loud opt-out for sensitive projects.

client-site.notes: CLIENT work. Real customers, contracts, money. Never auto-push.

nathanbot.notes: This system. Self-improvement changes land here.

ingest._comment: Pluggable external sources. Enable as needed; each maps external items into tasks/open/.
